patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LeadIQ and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

LeadIQ and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Workflow advantage: LeadIQ leans data-enrichment; Salesloft leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LeadIQ and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo.; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Company-size focus: LeadIQ (small-business, mid-market) vs Salesloft (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: LeadIQ-leaning data-enrichment vs Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid LeadIQ if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
